indexes.name: jobs_active_dedup_uniq_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_active_dedup_uniq_idx ON public.jobs USING btree (dedup_key) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::"JobStatus", 'running'::"JobStatus"])) AND (dedup_key IS NOT NULL))
indexes.reason: At most one pending or running job per dedup_key; a partial unique index Prisma cannot express (the queue relies on it instead of a find-then-insert).

indexes.name: jobs_attempts_gt1_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_attempts_gt1_idx ON public.jobs USING btree (attempts) WHERE (attempts > 1)
indexes.reason: Partial index over retried jobs (attempts > 1) for the queue insights report; Prisma cannot express a WHERE clause.

indexes.name: jobs_succeeded_duration_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_succeeded_duration_idx ON public.jobs USING btree (finished_at, started_at, type) WHERE ((status = 'succeeded'::"JobStatus") AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (finished_at IS NOT NULL))
indexes.reason: Partial index over finished succeeded jobs for the duration percentiles of the queue insights report; Prisma cannot express a WHERE clause.

indexes.name: database_backup_runs_active_uniq_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX database_backup_runs_active_uniq_idx ON public.database_backup_runs USING btree ((true)) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::"DatabaseBackupStatus", 'running'::"DatabaseBackupStatus"]))
indexes.reason: At most one pending or running database backup at a time: a constant-expression partial unique index Prisma cannot express.

indexes.name: organizations_default_uniq_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX organizations_default_uniq_idx ON public.organizations USING btree ((true)) WHERE is_default
indexes.reason: Exactly one default organization: a constant-expression partial unique index Prisma cannot express (the default org is a database fact, not a findFirst check).

indexes.name: group_invites_pending_uniq_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX group_invites_pending_uniq_idx ON public.group_invites USING btree (group_id, email) WHERE ((accepted_at IS NULL) AND (declined_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NULL))
indexes.reason: At most one PENDING invite per group and address; a declined, revoked or accepted invite does not block re-inviting the address, which a plain @@unique([groupId, email]) would. Prisma cannot express a partial unique index.

indexes.name: grants_active_user_uniq_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX grants_active_user_uniq_idx ON public.grants USING btree (resource_type, resource_id, grantee_user_id) WHERE ((grantee_kind = 'user'::"GrantGranteeKind") AND (revoked_at IS NULL))
indexes.reason: At most one ACTIVE grant per resource and user (one role per grantee, kvox's rule); a revoked grant does not block a new one. The grants API upserts on it. Prisma cannot express a partial unique index.

indexes.name: grants_active_group_uniq_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX grants_active_group_uniq_idx ON public.grants USING btree (resource_type, resource_id, grantee_group_id) WHERE ((grantee_kind = 'group'::"GrantGranteeKind") AND (revoked_at IS NULL))
indexes.reason: At most one ACTIVE grant per resource and group; a revoked grant does not block a new one. The grants API upserts on it. Prisma cannot express a partial unique index.

indexes.name: android_app_releases_one_current_uniq_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX android_app_releases_one_current_uniq_idx ON public.android_app_releases USING btree ((true)) WHERE is_current
indexes.reason: At most one current Android APK release deployment-wide: a constant-expression partial unique index Prisma cannot express. Make-current clears the old flag and sets the new one in one transaction; the index arbitrates concurrent calls (the loser gets 409), never a findFirst pre-check.
